name: BWX Technologies, Inc.
moat_justification: Sole-source naval nuclear monopoly with extreme licensing/security barriers and a $8.4B backlog, but government-contract pricing limits pricing power, ROIC has fallen from 19.2% to 12.2% and gross margin from 27.1% to 22.9% over the last five fiscal years in fundamentals.json, so measured returns are only moderately above a normal cost of capital and are compressing as commercial mix and growth capex rise.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Strong sole-source naval nuclear franchise, moat 7/10 — but at $137.01 it does not clear 15% on TTM owner's earnings (6.8% weighted IRR, IV@15% $41.79); it would need to fall to $41.79 to clear the hurdle.
moat_for: Exclusive manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors and fuel for the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program
Only commercial heavy nuclear component manufacturer in North America
Backlog $8.4B, up 40% YoY, book-to-bill 1.7x in Q2 2026
ROIC proxy double-digit through the cycle: 19.2% (2020) to 12.2% (2025) in fundamentals.json
moat_against: ROIC proxy fell from 19.2% to 12.2% and gross margin from 27.1% to 22.9% over 2020-2025 — returns compressing
Pricing set inside U.S. government contracts — limited independent pricing power
Customer/program concentration in the U.S. Navy and DOE
Growth requires heavy capex and acquisitions, depressing conservative owner's earnings
